title: A coord ask cannot carry a session id: kbask redacts the UUID, so two sessions cannot tell each other how to be addressed
goal: kbask ask keeps in its text a UUID that names a live session/<id> presence lease of the store, while it still replaces every other UUID, a token and a key=value secret in ask text

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import redact;s='-'.join(['396fb440','d928','4c33','9f3a','b375f1a2bc1d']);o=redact.redact('address me as '+s);print(o);sys.exit(0 if s in o else 1)

import subprocess as s,sys,tempfile as t,os,json;st=os.path.join(t.mkdtemp(),'coord.db');J=lambda *a:'-'.join(a);sid=J('396fb440','d928','4c33','9f3a','b375f1a2bc1d');o2=J('11111111','2222','4333','8444','555555555555');tok='gh'+'p_'+'a1B2c3D4e5'*3+'xyz123';pw='Pass'+'12345x';kv='pass'+'word='+pw;s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/coord.py','--store',st,'claim','session/'+sid,'--ttl','600'],check=True,capture_output=True);r=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbask.py','ask','--store',st,'any','address me as '+sid+' not '+o2+' '+tok+' '+kv],capture_output=True,text=True);v=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/coord.py','--store',st,'get','ask/'+json.loads(r.stdout)['id']],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout;print(v);sys.exit(0 if sid in v and o2 not in v and tok not in v and pw not in v else 1)

clauses.clause: kbask ask keeps in its text a UUID that names a live session/<id> presence lease of the store, while it still replaces every other UUID, a token and a key=value secret in ask text

gates.question: How does kbask decide a GUID in ask text names a live session, and for which texts?
options: Look up each GUID of an ask or answer text (at most 8) as the lease session/ID with coord get; redact.redact takes the live ones as keep
Pass every GUID of an ask text through unchanged
gates.recommendation: Look up each GUID of an ask or answer text (at most 8) as the lease session/ID with coord get; redact.redact takes the live ones as keep

gates.question: The item's repro calls plain redact.redact with no store and expects a UUID kept, which cannot hold beside the goal (only a live session lease keeps one): which repro stands?
options: Replace the repro by the first half of check 0 (a store with a planted lease, then kbask ask)
Keep every UUID that follows the words 'address me as'
gates.recommendation: Replace the repro by the first half of check 0 (a store with a planted lease, then kbask ask)
gates.answer: Replace the repro by the first half of check 0 (a store with a planted lease, then kbask ask)

notes: Found 2026-10-24 by the SP-3trnelzv orchestrator: an ask to any that named its coord session id reached the other session with the id as 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 (redact reads a UUID as an object id), and cross-session messages between the two were held by different permission modes, so coord asks were the only channel and carried no address. Planning 2026-11-09: goal narrowed to the first option the bug names (keep a UUID that names a live presence lease), so the check can run it; the check plants a lease with coord.py claim and a token and a password assignment built at run time. Premise reproduces on the base (the ask text holds only zero UUIDs).
